summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path helper; exported it from monai/data/__init__.py; added the "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined autofunction subsection to docs/source/data.rst; and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests, temp dirs removed in finally). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. Deviations: typing is imported for type hints (spec says only os and json), and OSError from open() propagates unwrapped. No lines exceed 120 columns.
